email.subject: Re: Ferry timetable change, from October 9
email.body:
Tamsin Oduya said on October 9, in the ferry timetable change session: "The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November. The late sailing carried under ten passengers a night." Rolf Benedek answered in the same session: "The weekend timetable stays as it is; Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill."

So now the last weekday ferry leaves at 21:55 from November, and the weekend late sailings stay where they are. The weekday cut rests on ridership: under ten passengers a night on the 22:40 sailing. The weekend keeps its place because Friday and Saturday still fill it. Nothing said so far gives a fill figure for the weekend, only that the sailings still fill, and both halves are still unreviewed.

My read is that the weekday change is settled, and the weekend is being kept on demand rather than on habit. That suggests to me the Friday and Saturday fill claim should be checked against the same sailing and the same window as the under-ten count, so both halves stand on matching numbers. If that holds, nothing on the weekend side has to be re-timed, and the weekday cut can be planned without reopening the weekend.
